title: Arkret Encrypted Payload Envelope
description: Minimal ciphertext wire. purpose, effective scope and Event kind come from the frozen signed outer Event; mls_group_id is derived from that scope. The canonical pre-encryption header is reconstructed and is not duplicated on wire.

routing_context.description: Present only for a registered reaction outer Event kind. The reaction kind and routing_window=floor(unix_ms(outer.created_at)/3600000) are derived inputs to AAD/KDF and never wire fields. All non-reaction kinds forbid routing_context.

standard_mls_encryption_context.description: RFC 9420 application-message context bound to the accepted group state.

encryption_context.description: RFC 9420 application-message context for the accepted MLS group state.
